results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: Management says 'quarter-on-quarter growth will be there'. Revenue went ₹179 Cr, ₹252 Cr, ₹319 Cr over the last three quarters as the new Neemrana plant filled (50% utilisation is the FY27 plan, 80% in FY28). We assume a slower 13% step in Q3.
Exports run at about ₹50 Cr+ a quarter (FY27 plan about ₹200 Cr) and bus AC, now ₹5-6 Cr a month, is expected to deliver 'main revenue' in Q3 and Q4.
Operating margin slipped from 19% to 15% in Q2 on higher staff costs and mix. PLI and RIPS incentives are not yet booked, so we only allow a small recovery to about 16%.
risks: Margin could stay near 15% or fall further
UAE exports are weak on freight costs
Working capital is heavy (inventory about 2.5 months)
